name: Kyonyuu Clinic ~Bed no Naka de Ue mo Shita mo Osewasareru Yume no Nyuuin Seikatsu~
original_name: 巨乳クリニック ～ベッドの中で上も下もお世話される夢の入淫生活～
source:
The protagonist rescued a woman who was about to be run over by a car and got hit himself.

When returning to conscious, he was on a bed in the hospital.
Moreover, both of his legs were broken, bounded in cast and cannot move.

In the mid of confusion, a doctor and a nurse appeared.
The nurse was the woman whom he rescued and the doctor's daughter.

And so, a hospitalized life nursed and served by a beautiful doctor and nurse began!

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=953036]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公救下一名险些被车撞到的女子，自己却被车撞中。

恢复意识时，他已经躺在医院的病床上。而且，他的双腿都骨折了，打着石膏，无法动弹。

在一片混乱中，一名医生和一名护士出现了。那名护士正是他救下的女子，也是医生的女儿。

就这样，在美丽医生与护士的照料和服侍下，住院生活开始了！

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=953036]Getchu[/url]]
